# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Audited the current tree against the four pending reproduction-parameter amendments and confirmed the implementation is already present in tracked code, so no new tracked-file edits were required this turn. Current HEAD already exposes `low_temp_repro_ramp_width_c`, `tan_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l`, and `no2_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l`, reuses the shared `molt_mineral_factor_floor` and `molt_gh_excess_penalty_divisor` inside `gh_mineral_factor()`, and carries those knobs through invariants, shrimp preset metadata, scenario materialization, and regression coverage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the shrimp runtime, invariants, preset plumbing, and regression tests against the pending amendment list to determine whether production gaps still remained.
2. [Skipped] Prepared to patch the reproduction/runtime surfaces, but skipped tracked-file edits because the current HEAD already contains the cold-ramp parameter, explicit TAN/NO2 full-suppression points, and shared GH floor/divisor wiring requested by the amendments.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted validation covering reproduction factors, invalid-parameter rejection, malformed-save rejection, and shrimp preset-to-runtime materialization on the current tree.

## Validation Evidence

- Source audit confirmed `temp_repro_factor()` uses the named cold ramp width, `tan_repro_factor()` and `no2_repro_factor()` use explicit full-suppression parameters, and `gh_mineral_factor()` reuses the shared GH mineral floor/divisor knobs.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed with 16/16 tests, including named-parameter observability and extracted-knob behavior coverage.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation step_hours_rejects_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_before_simulation -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load malformed_current_save_with_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_is_rejected -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios shrimp_preset_mapping_carries_stage_runtime_fields_and_legacy_split -- --nocapture` passed.
- `git diff --name-only HEAD --` reported no tracked-file delta in the main repo; only the pre-existing `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` submodule dirtiness remains.

## Outstanding Risks

- I did not rerun the full workspace or full `tank_harness` suites; validation was targeted to reproduction regressions, invariant/save-load rejection, and scenario mapping.
- The working tree still contains unrelated pre-existing dirtiness outside this deliverable: `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and untracked `.ralph-burning/`.
